concept: EBS: encryption by default with KMS
tests: How to ensure all new EBS volumes and snapshots in the account are encrypted by default.
expected: Enable EBS encryption by default in account (Region) settings with a KMS key — all new volumes and their snapshots are encrypted automatically. Triggers: "encrypted by default", "across the account".
why_not: Manually encrypting files is unreliable; instance store is ephemeral; OS-level-only encryption isn't managed by AWS and complicates snapshots.
